evidence_quotes:
b. (All models except M1123 and “A2”
vehicles). Check all drivebelts tension
using belt tension gauge. Belt tension
should be 70 lbs (311 N) minimum.
statements.reason: The procedure for all models except M1123 and A2 specifies a 70 lbs (311 N) minimum for drivebelts, including new belts.
statements.statement: For a vehicle other than M1123 or A2, the specified minimum tension for a new accessory drivebelt is 70 lbs (311 N).

evidence_quotes:
b. (All models except M1123 and “A2”
vehicles). Check all drivebelts tension
using belt tension gauge. Belt tension
should be 70 lbs (311 N) minimum. If
belt tension is not at least 70 lbs (311 N),
adjust drivebelts (paragraph 3-82). Tension
should not be greater than 110 lbs (489 N)
for new belts; old belts 95 lbs (422 N).
statements.reason: Under the procedure for all models except M1123 and A2, new-belt tension should not exceed 110 lbs (489 N).
statements.statement: For a vehicle other than M1123 or A2, the specified maximum tension for a new accessory drivebelt is 110 lbs (489 N).
